messages:
Maya: Friday prompt potluck! Bring your worst/funniest prompt. I'll kick us off: 'Write a heartfelt breakup letter from my sourdough starter to me because I forgot to feed it.' :bread:
Sam: omg that's so good 😂 :joy: Mine: 'Roleplay as a barista who only answers in haikus and refuses to take orders until you offer a coffee pun.' :coffee:
Anika: lmao. here's a spicy one —```System: You are 'Sous-Chef-GPT' obsessed with cilantro. User: create a three-course menu where cilantro is a mandatory garnish in every dish. Tone: tragicomic, small moral at the end.``` :chef:
Devon: @Maya this thread is our new eval set, I'm stealing all of these for weekend chaos tests :eyes:
Ellie: also bonus whitespace prompt abuse:```Hey GPT, respond like a 90s AOL chatroom, include at least 12 emoticons and one solid gold fish fact.``` :floppy_disk: :fish:
ops-bot: lunch reminder — tacos back in the kitchen at 12:30. Not a drill. :taco: (bot message)
Zain: trying to top everyone: 'You are the office ficus. Convince the team you're entitled to a chair and a salary. Include tax deductions and watering schedule.' :seedling:
Sam: vote time! which of these should we slap on a sticker for the break room? reactions = :bread: sourdough letter, :coffee: barista haiku, :chef: cilantro menu, :seedling: ficus rant. type the emoji to vote.
Maya: I'll tally in 5. also if anyone actually runs the cilantro prompt pls share output, I need to cry-laugh at that menu. :eyes:
Ellie: whoever writes the ficus salary letter first gets a gif in DMs. stakes are high. :trophy:
Anika: taking notes for prompt-mutagen project. will anonymize before using. :nerd_face:
Sam: :coffee: here. also tagging @dev-squad because they deserve to suffer during standup tomorrow. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Maya: poll closed! final counts: :bread: 3, :coffee: 5, :chef: 2, :seedling: 1. coffee haiku wins. prize: Sam writes the ficus salary letter as a haiku-barista crossover.
Zain: deal. can't wait.
Maya: good weekend, everyone — bring more chaos next week. :sparkles:
